title: Lavender Towel Shelf With Drying Rack - 24.7-Inch Wall Mount Brass 3-Tier Hotel Style Train Rack, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Lavender, keep towels organized and drying neatly while freeing up floor space with a wall-mounted, hotel-style towel shelf, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. to match any decor.

  • Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Traditional, refined look complements classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures
  • Concealed screw mounting keeps the installation looking clean and finished
  • Brass construction for enduring everyday use

Specs

  • Product type: Three tier hotel style towel shelf with drying rack (train rack)
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 24.7 in x 10.4 in x 8.9 in
  • Projection: 3.5 in
  • Product weight: 5.6 lb
  • Included items: Towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces for a coordinated look.
